title: LEGIT: Live Eligibility Gating over Identifier Tries for Constrained Decoding of Heterogeneous Pages
abstract: arXiv:2611.10357v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A generative recommender names each candidate with a short token sequence, a Semantic ID, and recommends by generating those tokens. Some generative recommenders, including the Uber Eats search engine we are building, write a whole results page, stores with their menu items, in one decoding pass. Every Semantic ID on such a page must name a real store or item that is eligible for the search, such as a store that delivers to the user's location, and that is not already on the page. Each item must also belong to the store above it. A trie over the catalog keeps identifiers real, but eligibility and repetition change with every request and token, and the grammar-constrained decoder we tried could not enforce these changing rules exactly and quickly. We call this constraint LEGIT, for live eligibility gating over identifier tries. Numbering trie leaves depth first turns each rule into a range lookup over one store trie and one item

translated_title: LEGIT：基于标识符字典树的实时资格门控，用于异构页面的受限解码
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐器用一段简短的 token 序列（即语义 ID，Semantic ID）来命名每个候选，并通过生成这些 token 来完成推荐。一些生成式推荐器，包括我们正在构建的 Uber Eats 搜索引擎，会在一次解码过程中写出整个结果页面，其中包含商店及其菜单项。这样的页面上，每个语义 ID 都必须指向一个真实的、且符合本次搜索资格的商店或条目（例如，能够配送到用户所在位置的商店），并且尚未出现在该页面上；此外，每个条目还必须属于其上方的商店。在商品目录上构建字典树可以保证标识符的真实性，但资格性与重复性约束会随着每次请求和每个 token 动态变化，而我们尝试过的语法约束解码器无法既精确又快速地执行这些不断变化的规则。我们将这一约束命名为 LEGIT，即“基于标识符字典树的实时资格门控”。对字典树叶节点进行深度优先编号，可以将每条规则转化为对一棵商店字典树和一棵条目字典树的范围查找。
tldr: 提出 LEGIT 约束机制，通过对标识符字典树叶节点进行深度优先编号、把随请求和 token 动态变化的资格规则转化为高效的范围查找，使生成式推荐系统在整页解码时能精确且快速地保证每个语义 ID 真实、合规且不重复。
en_tdlr: LEGIT enables exact and fast enforcement of eligibility rules that change with every request and token during whole-page generative decoding, by depth-first numbering trie leaves so each constraint becomes a range lookup over store and item tries.
